semantic_slots.objects: Positive takes probability laws P and Q, their transition tables p and q, a real cap B, a common stopping rule and a nonnegative extended-real work observable. One real density L also serves as the likelihood limit. Negative supplies p, q, the padded tables, the constant stop and terminal charge from m, and the proof constructs P and Q on the same path space.
semantic_slots.domains: Both conjuncts use the product measurable space of Bool-valued sequences, with discrete Bool and finite histories Fin n → Bool. The filtration selects coordinates in range n and equals that from the length-n prefix map. This just reindexes prose coordinates 1,…,n as 0,…,n−1. The stop takes values in WithTop ℕ; work and charge are ENNReal-valued, densities and transition entries are real.
semantic_slots.quantifiers: For each positive instance a single L satisfies the entire conjunction; the budget is for every deterministic n, P-almost surely, and convergence/nonnegativity hold P-almost surely. The transferred stop is finite Q-almost surely. For each real m≥2 one pair of witness laws satisfies every clause at once, including every horizon and separately the almost-sure false tails under P and Q. Both normalizations apply at every history, not just positive atoms.
semantic_slots.assumptions: Realizes is actual cylinder-mass recursion under the respective measure and table. Supports is one-sided at positive P mass; the nonnegative tables sum to one. The pathwise cap, not an average, is a P-ae finite-horizon bound; the probability-one intersection over countable n gives the prose version, and n=0 forces B≥0. Positive assumes only P-ae finite stopping and finite P second moment for measurable work. Dropping common dummy padding strengthens the positive result without excluding any prose case. Negative assumes only m≥2, with the law and stopping properties proved for its witnesses.
semantic_slots.conclusion: Positive yields P-ae convergence of prefix likelihoods to a strongly measurable nonnegative L in L²(P), real second moment ≤exp B and mean one, Q = P.withDensity (ofReal ∘ L), Q≪P, a measurable finite-stop event of full Q measure, and separately finite work integrals with the displayed centered variance bound. Negative establishes that both padded laws have the prescribed conditional tables and support, stop after two active bits, have zero tails, meet the all-horizon averaged cap, and give P second moment one and Q first moment m. Its fixed family witnesses the freely posed prose existence claim without assessing discovery of a family.
semantic_slots.senses: Finite-prefix ratios are Q mass divided by P mass, with real division by zero totalized to zero. The budget vanishes at P-null histories, and zero p-terms in the Bool sum contribute zero, agreeing with the restricted sum using the required support condition. The positive limiting sequence uses deterministic n, not stopping indices; there is no requirement that W be known at τ. Q≪P is one-sided. W is finite P-ae by the second-moment assumption and Q-ae by absolute continuity; the separate extended-integral finiteness conclusions prevent spurious use of top.toReal. Negative uses P-expectations of finite-prefix costs, not pathwise caps, and the charge measures work, not the number of calls.
semantic_slots.constants: Empty depth is zero; probability sums and the L mean are one. Positive uses exponent two, exp B, and the factor exp B−1. Negative uses m≥2, p=m⁻² and q=m⁻¹, second true-bit probabilities p and one after true, zero after false, and zero padding thereafter. Stop and tail cutoff are two; the strict per-horizon cap below two implies the requested supremum at most two. The nonzero terminal charge is m² on true,true, giving P second moment one and Q first moment m. The Lean family permits real m and hence includes the prose integer family.
